generations.name: Launch (400 V)
generations.notes: Launch MY2025 on SPA2: 111 kWh gross (~107 usable), 400 V, DC up to 250 kW; Twin Motor and Twin Motor Performance. 2025 owners get the 2026 core computer free but keep the 400 V powertrain. Confidence: high for the boundary (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.electrive.com/2025/09/23/model-year-2026-volvo-ex90-gets-800-volt-technology ; https://www.cars.com/articles/new-800-volt-electrical-system-comprehensively-upgrades-2026-volvo-ex90-516056

generations.name: 2026 update (800 V)
generations.notes: Every MY2026 EX90 moves to an 800 V architecture (new motors, dual NVIDIA Orin computer); Volvo claims 155 miles in 10 min on a 350 kW charger (Volvo claim, not a test). Exact peak kW and pack figures to be researched per powertrain. Confidence: high for the boundary (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.electrive.com/2025/09/23/model-year-2026-volvo-ex90-gets-800-volt-technology ; https://www.cars.com/articles/new-800-volt-electrical-system-comprehensively-upgrades-2026-volvo-ex90-516056 ; https://www.volvocars.com/intl/news/articles/the-award-winning-ex90-just-levelled-up-with-faster-charging-and-new-advanced-features/
